summary.text: Russell L. Ott is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 26, which covers Calhoun, Lexington and Richland Counties.
He previously served in the S.C. House from a special election on October 29, 2013, through 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ott's official page lists a B.A. from Clemson University in 2000 and a master's in public administration from the University of South Carolina in 2003.
He was a town administrator for Elloree, North and Neeses, and worked for the South Carolina Farm Bureau from 2004 to 2013.
He was elected to the S.C. House in a special election on October 29, 2013, to fill the unexpired term of Harry L. Ott Jr., who resigned, and served there until 2024.
His Senate committees are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary and Rules.
